# wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread (Data Source)

Provides information about an Azure Active Directory authentication domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific Azure AD authentication domain
data "wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread" "corporate" {
  domain_name = "corporate.onmicrosoft.com"
}

# Reference it when creating an authentication domain mapping
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "azure_admins" {
  domain_id      = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate.id
  user_group     = "administrators"
  external_group = "Bastion Administrators"
}

# Expose non-sensitive Azure AD configuration
output "azuread_domain_info" {
  value = {
    id               = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate.id
    auth_domain_name = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate.auth_domain_name
    client_id        = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate.client_id
    entity_id        = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate.entity_id
    is_default       = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate.is_default
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `certificate` (String, Sensitive)
- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `entity_id` (String)
- `external_auths` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `label` (String)
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `secondary_auth` (List of String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Key

- `domain_name`: The Azure AD authentication domain name to look up (Required). The data source
  fails if no authentication domain with this name exists.

### Returned Attributes

- **id**: Internal Bastion ID, usable as `domain_id` in `wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping`.
- **auth_domain_name**, **entity_id**, **client_id**, **label**, **description**: Domain
  identification and Azure AD application registration attributes.
- **default_email_domain**, **default_language**, **is_default**: Domain defaults applied to
  users authenticating through this domain.
- **external_auths**, **secondary_auth**: Lists of related external/secondary authentication
  domain references.

### Sensitive Fields

The schema also declares `certificate`, `client_secret`, `passphrase`, and `private_key` as
sensitive attributes, mirroring the corresponding resource. However, the Bastion API does not
return these secret values on read, so they are always empty when read through this data source
(the resource's `private_key` is explicitly never round-tripped from the API either). Do not
rely on this data source to retrieve or diff these secrets.

### Usage in Resources

Use the returned `id` as the `domain_id` when creating a
`wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping` resource to map Azure AD groups to Bastion user groups.
